title: Feedback-loop features must close the loop in SMOKE

facts.note: Plan artifacts the planner authors; the feature YAML holds the kind: line, WMBTs hold SMOKE acceptances.
Task wording that signals feedback-loop feature or SMOKE acceptance authoring.

values: SMOKE acceptance added/edited on a feedback-loop feature
facts.note: Requires parsing the feature YAML kind: field and the acceptances of its WMBTs (the presence validator does this; the router does not yet).

values: feedback-loop feature with no SMOKE acceptance whose close_the_loop block carries both consumer_reacted and drift_resolved
facts.note: Emitted by the presence validator test_feedback_loop_convention_fault.

fires: Planner authors or edits a feature marked kind: feedback-loop and its WMBT SMOKE acceptances.
A feedback-loop feature's only SMOKE acceptances assert artifact existence or schema validity of the producer output.
No SMOKE acceptance on a feedback-loop feature has a close_the_loop: block carrying both consumer_reacted and drift_resolved (e.g. the only close_the_loop blocks each miss one of the keys).
doesNotFire: Features whose kind is not feedback-loop.

A feedback-loop feature where at least one SMOKE acceptance has a close_the_loop: block with both consumer_reacted and drift_resolved, even if other SMOKE or non-SMOKE acceptances lack such a block or carry an incomplete one.
A feedback-loop feature whose kind: line carries an unexpired dated atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD hatch.

when: The planner authors or revises its WMBTs and SMOKE acceptances.
then: At least one SMOKE acceptance must declare a `close_the_loop:` block carrying both `consumer_reacted` (the consumer-side assertion the test makes) and `drift_resolved` (the convergence assertion).
prefer: Add (or extend) a SMOKE acceptance on the feature's primary WMBT with a close_the_loop: block declaring consumer_reacted and drift_resolved.
Phrase them so the test asserts the consumer actually received the correction and a producer re-run yields 0 new corrections for the same drift.
avoid: Producer-only SMOKE assertions (artifact existence, schema validation) as the sole SMOKE coverage.
A close_the_loop: block with only one of the two keys.
consumer_reacted satisfied by a fake send-history.
unless: The kind: line carries the dated hatch `kind: feedback-loop  # atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD`; dated, so the debt expires.
why: Producer-only smoke assertions give false-positive green CI while the loop's consumer end is never exercised.
evidence: Every feature with kind: feedback-loop has ≥1 SMOKE acceptance whose acceptance block contains close_the_loop: with both consumer_reacted and drift_resolved keys.
The corresponding test asserts real consumer receipt of the correction (not a fake send-history) and that a producer re-run yields 0 new corrections for the same drift.
Otherwise, the feature kind: line carries an atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) marker with an UNTIL date not yet passed.
verifier_detail: Trigger: feature YAML kind == feedback-loop. Pass: at least one SMOKE acceptance whose acceptance block has a close_the_loop field containing both consumer_reacted and drift_resolved (term close_the_loop_block: the SMOKE acceptance field that proves the loop closed).

Suppression: inline comment on the feature YAML kind: line of the form `# atdd:suppress(planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD`; dated so the debt expires — expired markers no longer suppress.
audit: schema_version 1.0.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 3.79.0.
source: legacy_path src/atdd/tester/conventions/smoke.convention.yaml, legacy_section feedback_loop_rules, legacy_rule_id planner.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop, extraction_mode high_fidelity.

splitSuggestion.then: The SMOKE test implementing a close_the_loop acceptance must assert the consumer actually received the correction (not a fake send-history) and that re-running the producer yields 0 new corrections for the same drift.

additions.text: S018 is a test-implementation obligation (tester audience); kept here in prefer/avoid/evidence as the planner's phrasing of the acceptance, and proposed as separate tester convention tester.smoke.feedback-loop-close-the-loop-assertions.
additions.justification: One obligation per then; the planner declares the block, the tester implements the real assertions.

additions.text: Other SMOKE or non-SMOKE acceptances lacking a complete close_the_loop block do not fire the rule when at least one SMOKE acceptance qualifies.
additions.justification: Derived from the statement's existential 'at least one SMOKE acceptance' scope; makes activation boundary explicit.

trace.note: Also proposed as a separate tester convention in splitSuggestion.
